tolerances.display: half one unit of the last displayed digit; exact-value evidence still required
tolerances.unavailable: expected unavailable/held is a valid outcome only when explained accurately

checks.title: Open and identify the pilot
checks.pass_condition: Launch the selected committed application, connect to the selected fictional workspace, identify its offline/synthetic scope, acknowledge the predeclared trial budget, and distinguish local access from financial or production approval.

checks.title: Research: periods, figures and source
checks.pass_condition: Identify FY2023-2025, revenue EUR 800m/900m/1bn, FY2025 operating margin 12% and FCFF EUR 80m; trace an exact figure to its retained supplied observation and explain missing earlier cash-flow components.

checks.title: Research: conditional value and unavailable research
checks.pass_condition: Explain the explicit valuation assumptions and fictional quote date; distinguish a conditional model value from a broker target, and identify unavailable consensus/named analyst research without inventing recommendations.

checks.title: Monitoring: stable breach and missing observation
checks.pass_condition: Explain the 2 to 3.5 to 3.5 leverage history against below 3: new then stable active breach. Explain that missing latest coverage is unavailable, not its earlier value 4, and that this supplied-history run is not a contractual covenant certification or persistent monitoring cycle.

checks.title: Events: historical arithmetic and held inference
checks.pass_condition: Identify one event/issuer, abnormal returns 1%, 2%, 3% and CAR 6%; explain the supplied market-model basis, unverified event provenance/design, held inference and absence of a next-event forecast.

checks.title: News: coverage, duplicates and unavailable tone
checks.pass_condition: Reconcile five supplied articles: one stale, one unrelated, one duplicate pair and one relevant unscored story. Explain 2 positive tokens / 6 words = 1/3 for the scored story; distinguish unavailable tone from neutral and the frozen cutoff from current news.

checks.title: Close: reconcile budget and actual
checks.pass_condition: Reconcile YTD profit 36000 to 39000 cents: sales +6000 cents, costs +3000 cents, net profit +3000 cents. Explain cost-versus-profit sign and any forecast assumptions, with no company/controller approval inferred.

checks.title: Record and revisit review decisions
checks.pass_condition: Save an exact-scope question and change request, reopen and acknowledge an item, retrieve its history, and explain why notes/acknowledgements do not release financial restrictions or authenticate an approver.

checks.title: Link a correction and deliberately rerun
checks.pass_condition: Import the fictional research successor with FY2025 operating income 130m, link it to the original version without automatic execution, explicitly run it, reconcile margin 13% and FCFF 87.5m, and verify separate new review with original history retained. Explain that this single-field fictional change is an arithmetic/lineage exercise, not a reconciled company restatement.

checks.title: Navigate complete evidence and reconnect
checks.pass_condition: For all five families use a chart with keyboard controls and exact values, inspect its source, compare the complete reading copy/download and original history, reconnect to the same saved result, and distinguish observation/cutoff from retrieval time.

checks.title: Freeze installation and supported configuration
checks.pass_condition: Record a clean candidate commit, source/build/lock/configuration/input-manifest fingerprints, full environment and fresh doctor/build checks. Unsupported or changed identities remain held.

checks.title: Verify local access and private delivery
checks.pass_condition: Refuse unauthorised/cross-origin access and changed/exposed keys, verify restart rotation and no-store delivery, and inspect the allowlisted diagnostic for seeded secret/name/path leakage.

checks.title: Replay a request without duplicate consequence
checks.pass_condition: Same key/body returns the original identity; changed body conflicts. Preserve one claimed attempt and no duplicate accounting result, including concurrent job-history reads during a worker commit.

checks.title: Handle uncertain and stale review saves
checks.pass_condition: Lost acknowledgements keep the exact original retry identity; stale report/history or changed bodies refuse. Reconnection cannot silently redirect a save or lose confirmed review history.

checks.title: Keep source-use and stale-data holds
checks.pass_condition: In isolated copies expire/revoke content-scoped permission and alter source/evidence; preserve stored history while refusing dependent reads/actions/backup. Missing, stale or incompatible observations never become substituted current facts.

checks.title: Enforce declared input and storage limits
checks.pass_condition: Exercise eligible at-bound inputs and one-over refusals, pending-job/evidence capacity and safe storage-write failures using separate fault fixtures. No partial accepted result, truncation or automatic deletion.

checks.title: Recover a complete saved delivery
checks.pass_condition: In a controlled copy fail publication after completion, recover the verified original result twice, retain attempt one and original operation receipt, and observe zero financial dispatch/calculation calls during recovery.

checks.title: Hold unknown outcomes and inspect close commits
checks.pass_condition: A missing/changed completion proof cannot trigger another attempt. Private recovery refuses active server/worker/surviving mutator. A failed close requires committed-versus-no-commit inspection; derived output recovery never repeats its accounting commit.

checks.title: Restore complete local evidence into a new copy
checks.pass_condition: Snapshot the quiescent full pilot workspace; verify/restore to a new destination; immediately audit without a server/key; compare inputs, results, reviews and accounting evidence. Rotate keys, hold queued work, refuse corruption/existing destinations, and preserve the original.

checks.title: Rehearse an isolated update and recovery
checks.pass_condition: Use separate candidate/previous installations and snapshot copies; check exact readiness and an injected candidate failure, preserve previous-code recovery and original source, and do not automatically activate/migrate/release a queue.

checks.title: Use operational and support guidance
checks.pass_condition: Inspect normal, held, failed and unreadable states through Operations/Storage/Installation/Privacy/Recovery and the offline runbook. Unknown counts remain unknown; the redacted check is reviewed before any separate sharing.

checks.title: Measure the exact sequential trial workload
checks.pass_condition: Record every read/write/job duration, six original calculation identities, workspace start/peak/end logical bytes and zero provider/model usage. Meet the predeclared trial targets or record failure; installation/cache/snapshot/fault-copy size is reported separately.

checks.title: Assemble version-bound evidence
checks.pass_condition: All 7B/7C checks have an expected/actual result, final supported candidate binding, evidence hashes, actor and retained attempt history. Assisted/failed/stale results need a separate valid retest; no historical component report is copied as a new pilot pass. Freeze the pre-decision pack with the explicit human-decision check still pending.

checks.title: Record the scoped readiness decision
checks.pass_condition: Review all current trial results, unresolved dependencies, accepted limitations and suspension conditions. Record a distinct explicit pilot decision against the exact candidate; do not mark production or financial approval through the evidence record.
